releaseNotes: LifeOS v1.5.7 (Build 17): Auto-hiding OneStop navigation bar on scroll, instant scroll-to-top interface transitions, fluid page glide entrance animations, end-to-end interactive card micro-interactions (Chrono-Clock, Dumbbell spring plates, fluid checkboxes, water ripple beaker, laundry drum), and time-adaptive Circadian Ambient Mesh background.
